title: Load test — lock impact
description: One load-test run at a time, picked from the Run dropdown: peak throughput, CoreBank's execution p95 (where a lock held across publishing shows up as waiting), and the processed-per-second curve. Run identity: CoreBankDemo.LoadTests/AppHost.cs stamps the OTel resource attribute run.id (a local timestamp, one per `aspire start`) on both APIs through OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES. Prometheus keeps it on target_info only, as the label run_id (it is not a promoted attribute), so every metric query joins it on: metric * on(job, instance) group_left(run_id) target_info{run_id="$run"}. Spelling: run.id (OTel attribute, TraceQL) and run_id (Prometheus label) are the same attribute.

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.description: Load-test runs in the dashboard's time range, newest first: the run.id stamp of the LoadTests AppHost, read back from Prometheus target_info as run_id.

panels.title: Throughput (peak)
panels.description: Highest transactions-processed-per-second rate CoreBank reached during the selected run (both replicas summed, 15 s rate window over the 1 s metric export). Scoped to $run by joining run_id from target_info. Min step 5 s: the LGTM Prometheus datasource defaults to a 60 s step, which hides a run that lasts less than a minute.

panels.title: Execution p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of CoreBank's transaction execution time over the whole selected run (corebankdemo.transaction.execution.duration, the executor call: lock acquisition, account loads, balance update). About 5 ms on the default build; with Demo:LockRelease = afterPublish every transfer first waits for the accounts another transfer still holds until its events are published, and that wait lands here. The histogram counters start at zero with each run's processes, so the last point of the series is the run's own p95. Scoped to $run by joining run_id from target_info. Min step 5 s: the LGTM Prometheus datasource defaults to a 60 s step, which hides a run that lasts less than a minute.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (corebankdemo_transaction_execution_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="CoreBank.CoreBankAPI"} * on(job, instance) group_left(run_id) target_info{run_id="$run"}))

panels.title: Transactions processed / s
panels.description: CoreBank transactions processed per second over the selected run, both replicas summed (15 s rate window over the 1 s metric export). Scoped to $run by joining run_id from target_info. Min step 5 s: the LGTM Prometheus datasource defaults to a 60 s step, which hides a run that lasts less than a minute.
